cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You've locked the shop. You can stop doing the cheerful voice for me. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone has to keep morale up. You're my only employee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'm off the clock. What did that empty till do to you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cried in the stockroom. Then I practised smiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't owe me a second performance. Can we lock the stockroom and let you be upset out here?

mechanism: An employee confidently manages closing while accommodating the boss morale duty, persuading the boss to stop hiding distress from A.
confusable: Unlike asking for a business report, A seeks unperformed emotion; borrowed authority offers to finish work so the boss can cooperate.
comparison: Employee and shop owner negotiate visible distress, unlike a friend negotiating private company at home.
seedUse: D108-a empty till, morale and stockroom crying; S02-b adapts direction in response to partner concern.
